preconditions.description: S and P are both strings.
The lengths of S and P are between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in P)
preconditions.description: All characters in S and P are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.description: The output is either a substring of S or '-1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(c in stdout for c in P and stdout.count(c) >= P.count(c))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', it contains all characters of P with at least the same frequency.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or len(stdout) == min(len(window) for window in [S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1) if all(c in S[i:j] and S[i:j].count(c) >= P.count(c) for c in P)])
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', it is the smallest window containing all characters of P.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(i == 0 or len(S[i:j]) < len(S[i-1:j]) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i+1, len(S)+1) if all(c in S[i:j] and S[i:j].count(c) >= P.count(c) for c in P) and len(S[i:j]) == len(stdout))
postconditions.description: If there are multiple smallest windows, the output is the one with the least starting index.
